notes: Replaces the old Contracts Test and Onboarding Test sidebar entries with the real workflow. Contracts now has direct Pending and Signed Dropbox links plus a highlighted CHECK action per candidate. Marking a contract Signed automatically adds the candidate to the new Onboarding page. Onboarding has direct Amazon progress checks, 12-hour check-due tracking, quick 14/15 training and 15/15 complete actions, and a clickable Home widget showing active, due and training-needed candidates. Existing signed candidates appear in Onboarding automatically as well.
